captions.detailed: A decorative double-leaf driveway swing gate flanked by two robust stone-like pillars. The pillars are rectangular, gray, and topped with flat caps on a matching concrete foundation. The two symmetrical black metal gate leaves feature rectangular outer frames, vertical pickets with pointed tips, and a central circular motif divided by crossbars. Each gate leaf is mounted to its respective pillar via two pintle hinges, allowing them to swing open and closed independently.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a double-leaf decorative driveway swing gate. It should feature two large gray rectangular pillars on a solid base, and two symmetrical black ornamental metal gate panels with vertical pickets and central circular designs. Ensure both the left and right gate panels can rotate independently on revolute hinge joints attached to their respective pillars.
captions.factory: The code defines a fixed base assembly containing the concrete foundation and the two vertical pillars with decorative top caps, modeled using box primitives. It then constructs two symmetrical gate leaf parts, using thin boxes for the outer frames, cylinders for the vertical pickets, and thin extruded rings with crossbars for the central circular ornaments. Finally, the assembly is parameterized with two revolute joints (articulations) representing the pintle hinges, mapping the left and right gate panels to their respective pillars with specified rotational axes and limits.
